question: What kind of knowledge is required to understand the present Shaiva domain correctly?
premises: A merely partial element does not contain the full meaning.
The present domain concerns the meaning of the Shaiva scripture.
Correct understanding requires knowledge of that meaning in its complete form.
inference: In this domain, only complete knowledge of the Shaiva scriptural meaning is adequate.
plain_english: —is that the meaning of only that much. Thus, in the present domain, understanding must come through knowledge of the entire meaning of the Shaiva scripture in its complete form.
